exposure: mode of delivery of second twin (vaginal, cesarean section)
mode of delivery of first twin (vaginal, cesarean section)
outcome: mode of delivery for first and second twin
cohort: 343 women with twin pregnancies planned for trial of vaginal delivery between January 2014 and December 2019.
finding: The use of epidural analgesia during labor in twin pregnancies was associated with a reduced cesarean section rate for both the first and second twin.
